explication: ESP8266 Deauther is firmware for testing 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi networks, with a browser interface and an on-device display. The main workflow is to scan nearby access points and stations, select targets, and invoke an attack; the README also describes creating many networks to confuse Wi-Fi scanners. The tree identifies separate scan, target-list, attack, and SSID modules, but their implementations were not sampled, so the graph omits uncertain internal call wiring. The web command flow is visible in the scan UI excerpt; other browser-to-firmware links are shown only where supported by that flow.
